'''Clak'dor V''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and former prison colony in the [[Colu system]].

==History==
Several decades ago, the planet was a prison world of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] species. Roughly around [[3630 BBY]], the ruins have been rediscovered but the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] forbade any outsider to study them.<ref name="HiddenSins" />
